files.docs/rollout-notes.md:
# Rollout notes — reference lookup

The lookup helper was extracted so that posting and archival share one copy of
the reference query. The academies imported their first term with the shared
helper in place.

Archival runs on the last working day of the month.
files.ledger/archival.py:
"""Month-end archival for the tuition ledger."""

from ledger.lookup import find_reference

ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS = 400


def is_archived(ledger, reference):
    """Return True when the reference has already moved to the archive."""
    entry = find_reference(ledger, reference)
    return bool(entry and entry.get("archived"))
files.ledger/posting.py:
"""Posting rules for the tuition ledger."""

from ledger.lookup import find_reference


class PostingError(Exception):
    """Raised when an entry cannot be posted."""


def post_entry(ledger, entry, clerk):
    """Post a tuition entry to the ledger.

    An entry whose reference is already on the ledger is refused with
    PostingError, so the same payment is never recorded twice.
    """
    ledger.append(entry.reference, entry.amount_cents, clerk)
    return entry.reference
